hard_fail_rules.rule: Player-facing text contains analyst/system jargon from the blocked glossary.
A diagnostic or causal sentence has no evidence_ids or comparison basis.
More than one active correction cue is given in the primary coaching card.
Narration/caption discusses a body event or consequence not visible in the compiled story beat.
Positive language is not tied to an evidenced strength.
Player mode exposes an unsupported exact angle, millisecond, or contact frame.
Language reproduces distinctive wording from a source or asks the model to imitate a named coach.
Correction could be pasted onto almost any tennis stroke without changing meaning.

robotic_phrase_patterns: A key area for improvement is
semantic_checks: coach_read and change must describe the same selected primary insight
why must include at least one movement consequence or ball consequence
feel must be one cue, not a list separated by semicolons/slashes/and-then instructions
watch must point to a visible event/overlay in the visual story
train must constrain one main variable and define a finite practice set or clear task
success must be observable or feelable by the player and must not depend only on an internal model score
keep may appear only when a strength has evidence
no-major-correction reports must not invent a defect
